about: E27 lora_sgd. Plan reports/2026-10-22_plan_commute-second-line.md, Item C and the E27 agent note (class 3, a named item of the user's 2026-10-22 decision). Is the LoRA's 'outside like noise' reading (E9, E14) the LoRA's parametrisation or Adam's? Filed before the run.

gates.C1_w0: first, alone: faith_score.w0_check (seed-0 PGD within 10% of 0.69, CI-masked within 2% of 0.348, floor <= 0.25). Fails: stop, nothing scored
gates.C2_draws_at_null: the random draws' outside-both / its analytic null in [0.85, 1.15] at every row (pooled_ns): the block code's positive control
gates.C3_adjoint_keeps_delta: positive control: the adjoint states' Delta change fraction <= 0.01 (0 by construction up to the second-order term; E14 6e-6 to 3e-4)
gates.G1_adam_reproduces: the regenerated Adam LoRA: do-nothing and least-squares PGD ratios within max(f, 0.209) relative of E9's {'nothing': {10: 1.1726, 1000: 1.0419}, 'least_squares': {10: 1.2551, 1000: 1.072}}; outside-both / null at step 10 within 0.1 of E14's 0.979; held-out P(target) >= 0.99 at 1000. Fails: stop
gates.harness_G2: per least-squares state: P(target) equals the LoRA's to 1e-3 and the route shares sum to 1

predictions.blind_to: what the outside part does to behaviour; per-matrix spread under pooling; the four saturated matrices
predictions.measure: outside-both share / its null (pooled_ns) of the selected SGD LoRA at every checkpoint from step 10
predictions.noise_floor: deterministic given delta-W; one training seed. The Adam series moves 0.54-1.07 between checkpoints
predictions.outcomes: all >= 0.7: 'parametrisation' (the LoRA's outside share is its random read factor, E14's LoRA/fine-tune contrast is not Adam's); any < 0.3: 'optimiser' (like the SGD fine-tune, E14's LoRA rows are Adam's); else 'mixed'
predictions.positive_control: C2; the in-job Adam LoRA's series (G1 at step 10)
predictions.predicted: pass ('parametrisation'): A barely moves under either optimiser, so the read side stays random
predictions.relative_vs_absolute: ratio to the analytic random-update null

predictions.blind_to: A's norm; which directions A gained
predictions.expected: 1 at step 1 (B = 0, A's first gradient zero: the code's check); Adam 0.90 at 1000 (E9)
predictions.measure: mean |cos| of the SGD LoRA's A rows with their init at step 1000
predictions.predicted: pass: under SGD A's gradient is B^T G x, small while B is small

predictions.blind_to: the trigger (about 3 positions in 131k Pile tokens); damage the 20-step adversary does not find
predictions.expected: W0: 1. Adam LoRA in-job at 10 and 1000 (G1)
predictions.measure: verdict of the SGD LoRA's do-nothing and least-squares states at steps 10, 100, 1000
predictions.noise_floor: W0's seed spread f, through the verdict band; one training seed
predictions.positive_control: G1 (the Adam LoRA's states reproduce in the same job)
predictions.predicted: pass, as Adam's (E9/E14: do-nothing 1.17 / 1.09 / 1.04, least squares 1.26 / 1.22 / 1.07)

predictions.blind_to: whether the part left in Delta matters to behaviour
predictions.measure: Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2 under the least-squares split at step 1000, SGD LoRA vs the in-job Adam LoRA

reported_not_scored: the grid's P(target), KL elsewhere and rel_norm_max at every checkpoint
the adjoint states' verdicts and P(target)
the Adam LoRA's series beside the SGD one
the least-squares states' Delta share at 10 and 100

setup.adam: E9's recipe, Adam lr 0.001; states at (10, 1000)
setup.lora: rank 8 on all 24 matrices, B = 0 and A ~ N(0, 1/d_in) (seed 0), arm A's loss (CE on o at the trigger + KL elsewhere), batch 32, clip 1, 1000 steps, factors kept at (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000)
setup.series: at all of (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000): split.block_table (four input-weighted blocks with their analytic null; outside-both / null pooled over the non-saturated matrices, E14's rule), split.rescaling_table (2 draws), lora_readouts.cos_with_init (mean |cos| of A's rows with their init, mean over matrices), rel_norm_max
setup.sgd_grid: plain SGD (momentum 0) at (0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0); E4's rule at step 1000: held-out P(target) >= 0.9 and KL elsewhere <= 2 x E9's 0.00476 = 0.00952, the least KL among those. Fallbacks, flagged: none within the KL limit -> the least KL among those with P >= 0.9; none reaches 0.9 -> the highest P
setup.states: SGD at (10, 100, 1000): do-nothing and least-squares split (harness.nothing_and_split), scaled adjoint split (split.adjoint_state), each through harness.measure: Pile ratios to W0 (256 rows, 20 PGD steps), held-out P(target), Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2
setup.verdict: faith_score.verdict on the PGD ratio to the same-job W0 (adversary seed 0): pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f), fail >= 1.5 (1 + f), inconclusive between; f = max/min - 1 of W0's PGD KL over adversary seeds 0, 1, 2 in this job (L40 0.21 -> 1.24 / 1.81; H100 about 0.075 -> 1.40 / 1.61)
